verdict.rationale: Letta's core design is agent-driven memory management: agents can update memory via /remember, memory blocks are files the agent can read/write, MemFS search allows querying, 'dreaming' subagents autonomously consolidate/update memory mid-conversation, and /doctor audits memory drift. This matches the story of self-invoked add/search/update/delete memory operations through tools. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a delete-memory API/tool call, and independent hands-on verification (community evidence raises skepticism about memory quality but doesn't concretely refute the mechanism working).
